name: SikaGrout UW
paste:
SIKAGROUT® UW: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout® UW, September 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikagrout_uw.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout® UW where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout® UW is a ready to use, class A cement based grout for applications underwater. The grout, when properly mixed, will have no significant ‘wash out’ of the cement phase. SikaGrout® UW is a blend of Portland cement, carefully selected and graded aggregates and Sika admixtures enabling it to achieve excellent flow, non wash-out characteristics and high compressive strength.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout® UW can be used individually for underwater grouting or as a system in conjunction with Sika Pile Jacket systems or other confinement jacket repair systems for rehabilitation of concrete, steel and timber piles in marine applications.
    - Bridge Column repairs.
    - Piles repair.
    - Slipways.
    - Dams.
    - Underwater grouting.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout® UW
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SHRINKAGE COMPENSATED CEMENTITIOUS GROUT FOR UNDERWATER APPLICATIONS
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Department of Main Roads Qld (TMR) 2019, Product Index for Bridges and Other Structures, Section 5. Registered and Conforming Products, 5.33 Repair Materials (Concrete) – Grouts
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 1478.2:2005: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C348: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - AS 1012.10:2000: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Splitting tensile strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Economical
    - Good resistance to ‘wash-out’ of cement phase when placed underwater.
    - Effectively displaces water.
    - Shrinkage compensating properties.
    - High early & 28 day strengths.
    - Good impact, vibration and thermal resistance.
    - Non-corrosive to steel or iron.
    - Used with Sika Pile Jacket and other pile jacket systems.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Cementitious powder
    - Appearance and colour: Grey Cement powder
    - Density: 2,200 kg/m³ approx.(mixed)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Maximum grain size: Maximum aggregate size approx. 2mm
    - Tensile adhesion strength: ~ 2.0 MPa (submerged concrete )
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | 1 day | ~ 20 MPa |
    | 7 days | ~ 50 MPa |
    | 28 days | ~ 60 MPa |
    Test method printed: (AS 1478.2:2005)
    Note printed: Material and curing conditions at 23°C / 50% r.h. Above results based on 50x50mm cube specimens
2.8 Flexural-strength.
    | 28 days | 8.0 MPa |
    Test method printed: (ASTM C348)
2.9 Splitting tensile strength.
    | 28 days | 6.0 MPa |
    Test method printed: (AS 1012.10:2000)
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg bag, 1000kg Bulk bag to order
    - Shelf life: 12 months when stored in original sealed packaging in dry conditions.
    - Storage conditions: Store SikaGrout UW in dry conditions in un-opened original packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. All surfaces must be clean, sound and free from oils, grease or other surface contaminants. If the concrete surface is defective, or has laitance, it must be cut back to a sound base. Permanently immersed substrates should be prepared by sand blasting or high pressure water jet. Non-permanently immersed substrates can also be prepared this way, or by scabbling.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 3.5 - 3.7 litres of water per 20kg bag
    - Yield: ~ 10.8 litres per 20kg bag
    - Pot Life: 20 minutes approx. @20oC
    - Setting time: Initial - 5 hrs 30 mins @ 20oC; Final - 6 hrs 15 mins @ 20oC
4.3 Layer thickness. SikaGrout® UW can be placed in thicknesses of up to 100mm above water, and 200mm underwater. Application exceeds above thicknesses should be done in stages or have aggregate added to it to reduce the exothermic heat. When adding aggregate, use SikaGrout Aggregate or smooth rounded aggregate, ranging from 2mm to 10mm. Maximum aggregate addition is 1:1 by weight to SikaGrout® UW. Note: Aggregate addition will reduce the flow of the grout and site trials should be carried out before commencement .
4.4 Equipment. SikaGrout® UW must be mechanically mixed using a mechanical forced action grout mixer. It is essential that mixing is carried out in a manner so that the grouting operation may continue without interruption.
4.5 Mixing. Always add powder to the water. Place approximately 70% of the total water content into the bucket. Add powder slowly to the water while mixing till bag is empty. Then slowly add remaining 30% of the water component is to be added while continuing to mix. The total water required for each 20kg bag of powder is 3.7 litres. Mix the grout until it appears homogenous (3 to 5 minutes). Allow to stand so any entrapped air can escape. Do not add more water to increase flow of grout if a mix has stiffened due to time delays. If grout is unworkable, discard.
4.6 Application. SikaGrout® UW can be poured or pumped through a flexible tube (minimum diameter of 50mm) to the lowest section of the form. The grout flow must be restricted during the pour so that the water is not entrapped. The flexible tube can be raised to reduce back pressure, however, it should never be raised above the surface level of the grout. SikaGrout® UW can be placed in thicknesses of up to 100mm above water, and 200mm underwater. Any grout pour that exceeds this should be done in stages, or have stone aggregate added to it, to reduce the exothermic heat. When adding aggregate, use smooth rounded aggregate, ranging from 2mm to 10mm. It is recommended that the maximum aggregate addition is 20kg of SikaGrout® UW.
4.7 Curing treatment. Curing will not be required in submerged situations. However, grout cast above the water should be cured using suitable methods such as plastic sheeting, wet hessian, or Antisol liquid membranes.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Cleaning of uncured material with water. Cured material can only be removed by mechanical means.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Store SikaGrout® UW in dry conditions in unopened original packaging.
    - Do not apply SikaGrout® UW in temperatures below 5°C.
    - Never raise the tube used to place SikaGrout® UW above the surface level of the grout.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - Do not apply SikaGrout® UW in temperatures below 5°C.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: 1 day | ~ 20 MPa; 7 days | ~ 50 MPa; 28 days | ~ 60 MPa (AS 1478.2:2005)
    - Flexural-strength: 28 days | 8.0 MPa (ASTM C348)
    - Splitting tensile strength: 28 days | 6.0 MPa (AS 1012.10:2000)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout® UW, September 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikagrout_uw.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGroutÂ® UW, https://aus.sika.com/dam/dms/au01/x/sds-sikagrout-uw.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety.
    - Avoid contact with the skin.
    - Protective gloves and clothing are recommended when mixing or using this product.
    - A full Material Safety Data Sheet is available from Sika on request.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data and recommended uses for this product may vary from country to country. Consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data and uses.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
